summary: Citizens Financial Group filed an 8-K announcing a proposed public offering of new Series J Fixed-Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock. Proceeds, if the offering closes, would redeem some or all of its outstanding Series G Preferred Stock ($1,000 liquidation preference). Pricing and closing are subject to market conditions; no terms, premium, or board recommendation are provided. This is a liability management capital transaction, not a special situation like a tender offer or going-private. Watch for pricing terms and a subsequent redemption announcement.
